description: This file defines an interface for an authentication provider that verifies device credentials and supports health monitoring. It specifies a generic authenticate method that takes device credentials, an optional tracing span, and a handler for the asynchronous authentication result.

classes.name: HonoClientBasedAuthProvider
classes.description: An interface extending Vert.x's AuthProvider, providing a contract for authenticating device credentials with support for monitoring.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Validates provided device credentials against stored credential data, possibly involving tracing context. Calls the resultHandler with success or failure asynchronously.
